extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Humana plan available in Polk County has a $0 monthly premium, a $520 drug deductible and a $6600 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent failed to deliver the TPMO disclaimer before discussing benefits. The agent also used a superlative that was flagged as misleading.
composition.coaching_note: Marcus stated, 'Let's set your plan review for 4 days from now — that's 96 hours out, which gives you time to read it.' A more accurate statement would be, 'Let's set your plan review for 4 days from now, which gives you time to review the Scope of Appointment.'
